concept.subject: A long garden pergola of stone pillars and round arches on two tiers, hung with wisteria, on the highest terrace.
concept.composition: A row of six round arches on slender pillars spans the lower half from edge to edge, the arches' tops at half height; on each side of the open top center an upper tier of three smaller arches stands on the lower row, reaching a quarter of the height. Long wisteria clusters hang inside every arch; stone steps lead up along the bottom.
concept.layout: 34 round pegs and 110 bricks, the stage's finale. The architecture template's colonnade builds the arches, pillars and upper tiers from bricks; the wisteria clusters hanging inside the arches are short peg strings, the only pegs on the board.

difficulty.note: The stage's hardest: the wisteria pegs hang inside the arches, reachable only through the arches' mouths.

background.prompt: A long garden pergola stands on the highest terrace of a sunny flower garden in late spring. A row of six round arches on slender pale stone pillars spans the lower half of the picture from edge to edge, the arches' tops at about half the picture height; on each side of the open top center, an upper tier of three smaller arches stands on top of the lower row, reaching up to about one quarter of the height. Long clusters of wisteria blossoms in soft lilac-pink and cream hang inside every arch. Stone steps lead up to the pergola along the bottom; a clear, soft sky behind; the lower corners are plain stone.
